title: Yara and the Garden
author: Hazel Quintana
blurb: Paloma Crane, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
